The '''''Vindicator''-class heavy cruiser''' was the standard 600-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long [[Heavy cruiser/Legends|heavy cruiser]] design of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].

==Characteristics==
The ship's armament consisted of 25 light [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]], 20 light quad turbolasers, 20 point-defense [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], 20 light point-defense [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], and 6 [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] projectors organized into 5 light turbolaser batteries, 5 light quad turbolaser batteries, 4 laser batteries, 4 ion cannon batteries and one capital-grade tractor beam battery.<ref name="SotGSE" />

The Vindicator was equipped with a Class 2 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], a thickly armored hull, and heavy shielding.<ref name="AOR CRB" /> It carried 400 troops and a crew of 2,551.<ref name="SotGSE" /> Most Vindicators were specifically configured so that they could carry a full [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] wing and operate independently without the need for support ships.<ref name="SotG" /> Other configurations could carry only two squadrons of starfighters.<ref name="SotGSE" />

==History==
It was intended for use in situations in which [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] were unavailable, and smaller ships were not powerful enough. The ship was manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]].

They were to replace the [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]] as the Navy's standard multi-role cruiser.<ref name="AOR CRB" />

The [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] was designed using the same basic hull as the Vindicator. In addition to manufacturing new Immobilizer 418s, the Empire converted a number of Vindicators into Interdictor cruisers.<ref name="SotGSE" /> The Vindicator's hull was used again to build the [[Enforcer-class picket cruiser|''Enforcer''-class picket cruiser]], a patrol ship used by the [[Pentastar Alignment]].

The Vindicators were assigned as escorts or as lone hunters. Those postings were seen as prestigious by many young Imperial [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] due to the greater chances for personal glory and promotion.<ref name="AOR CRB" />

A ''Vindicator''-class heavy cruiser was present near the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] during [[X2]] and [[Grey Squadron]]'s [[Mission to Death Star I|mission]] there.<ref name="SWB:ES">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''</ref>

Some of these cruisers were eventually found in local fleets and large [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] squadrons, while an Imperial Vindicator called [[Molator (Vindicator-class)|''Molator'']] was captured by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="SotG" />

==Behind the scenes==
While the Vindicator was the original ship in-universe, and its existence had been implied for years, it was only given a name and description in the book ''[[Starships of the Galaxy]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]]. Because of this, the derivative Interdictor cruiser is far more well-known.

A ship of the same name is mentioned in the manual for ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'', but this appears to be a mislabelled [[Victory-class Star Destroyer|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]].
